commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "::warning::snapshot failed" >&2
  rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled …[per-command-truncated]

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext_out.txt 2>/tmp/ext_err.txt; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---STDOUT---"; cat /tmp/ext_out.txt; echo "---STDERR---"; cat /tmp/ext_err.txt

for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/create-issue/SKILL.md skills/docs-verify/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md; do wc -c "$f"; done; echo "---exemptions---"; cat lib/test/reference-size-exemptions.json

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
